name: Yupeng (Philip) Yang
headline: Hi, I'm Philip Yang.
intro: I study how technology reshapes law, work, and markets, and build projects that make hard ideas easier to learn.
now: Starting my first year at Vanderbilt
Growing Mock For All's mock trial tutorials on social media
Learning Python for data analysis and machine learning
contactLine: Looking for AI research, ML engineering, or quant internships. I'd love to hear from you.
bio: I grew up in Shenzhen, China, and came to Vanderbilt after four years of mock trial, debate, and independent research at BASIS International School Shenzhen.

My work so far sits where people meet systems: how delivery drones change jobs, how a divorce law affects families facing violence, and how free tutorials can open mock trial to students who never had a coach.
Next, I'm building technical skills in AI and quantitative finance so I can work on those questions with data, not just arguments.
